freeze_note: The final protocol was written before any regenerated drought publication join or new drought block outcome existed. Rules reuse the previously declared block analysis and previously defined multiscale support thresholds.
purpose: Test whether the positive AlphaEarth-reference correlations in the eight fixed development cases remain directionally stable after coarse spatial aggregation and are unusual under an approximate block-label permutation null.

known_before_freeze: All eight fine-H3 development-case Spearman point estimates were known to be positive.
The parent-level-2 block results for the three lava and two forest-loss cases had already been computed in a separate broader sensitivity analysis.
The three drought parent-block outcomes had not been computed.
This protocol is post hoc and is not held-out validation or a third-party preregistration.
prohibited_claims: confirmation of a semantic embedding axis

input_policy.regenerated_artifact_policy: If a missing artifact must be regenerated and its binary SHA-256 differs, stop before analysis. Record the mismatch and define a protocol amendment before inspecting any new block result.
input_policy.missing_event_policy: Stop the eight-case aggregate analysis. Do not replace or omit an event.

primary_analysis.parent_summary: unweighted arithmetic mean computed separately for ECS and the mapped reference
primary_analysis.statistic: two-sided Spearman correlation across retained paired parent means
primary_analysis.permutation_null: hold ECS parent means fixed and freely permute the complete mapped-reference parent-mean vector
primary_analysis.seed_derivation: Primary parent-level-2 tests use the existing stable SHA-256 derivation from event_key. Descriptive parent-level-1 and parent-level-3 tests use the same derivation from event_key plus ':parent_levels=<level>'.
primary_analysis.null_envelope_label: 95% permutation null envelope, not a confidence interval
primary_analysis.multiplicity: Holm family-wise adjustment across all eight primary per-event tests; ineligible events remain in the denominator and are reported as not assessable

scale_sensitivity.minimum_finite_cells_rule: ceil((7 ** parent_levels) / 7), preserving the primary one-seventh parent-capacity threshold; this gives 1, 7, and 49 cells for parent levels 1, 2, and 3
scale_sensitivity.selection_rule: No scale may replace the primary result. Report every eligible fixed scale.
scale_sensitivity.directionally_stable_definition: observed block Spearman is positive at every eligible fixed scale
scale_sensitivity.incomplete_scale_definition: not fully assessable, not a pass

report: positive and negative primary block-correlation count
median and range of primary block correlations
exact two-sided sign-test p-value as descriptive fixed-case evidence
aggregate_summary.interpretation: conditional summary of these eight fixed cases only

interpretation_rules.per_event_permutation_supported: positive primary block correlation and Holm-adjusted two-sided p-value below 0.05
interpretation_rules.directionally_stable: positive at every eligible fixed scale
interpretation_rules.spatially_robust_within_case: permutation-supported and directionally stable, with no scale selected by outcome
interpretation_rules.discordant_results: Report disagreement between fine-cell, primary-block, and scale-sensitivity results without privileging the favorable result.
interpretation_rules.manuscript_gate: Any manuscript statement must label this as a frozen post hoc spatial sensitivity and must not use it to convert development evidence into held-out validation.

forbidden_inputs: checkpoints or matrices from the invalidated dimension-correlation study
